body:
#### PR description:

This PR fixes the broken assignment operators of the `View` and the `ConstView` of the SoA backend. 
Also it fixes constness of the `const_element` returned by the `ConstView`

#### PR validation:

This PR is purly technical and is checked by running unit tests locally, also the SoA unit test is extended to check the changes

@felicepantaleo FYI
title: Fix SoA View assignment operators
